text:
Thought I’d share 2 bots that have been quite useful to me in the last week

Mr Dufrain: my accountant, walked me through maximizing my tax returns outstanding and got me a nice return, works with my investor and controls my accounts

https://x.ai/bot/aBkdS0Duc24Hz7MvNm7W5

And Spenny, I tell him what I’d like to purchase to improve my life, he researches the best purchases for me, and works with Dufrain to spread the purchases and fit my budget

https://x.ai/bot/2yC0HrEtcJe-XWxMO-4-M

Hope it’s of some use! Many more bot templates to come
